objects.name: material_relations

objects.name: resources
objects.sql:

objects.name: retrieval_evaluation_queries

objects.name: song_actions
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE `song_actions` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`song_title` text NOT NULL,
	`alternate_title` text,
	`tradition_performer` text,
	`action_wording` text,
	`normalized_action` text,
	`action_sequence` text,
	`song_cue` text,
	`action_classification` text,
	`core_or_optional` text,
	`age_range_stated` text,
	`educator_org` text,
	`source_title` text,
	`source_type` text,

objects.name: song_chord_guides
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE song_chord_guides (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  song_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES songs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  section_id INTEGER REFERENCES song_sections(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  scope TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (scope IN ('song', 'section', 'line')),
  line_number INTEGER,
  progression TEXT NOT NULL,
  musical_key TEXT,
  capo TEXT,
  tuning TEXT,
  meter TEXT,
  starting_pitch TEXT,
  provenance TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (provenance IN ('source-documented', 'expert-suggested', 'community-legacy')),
  source_note TEXT,
  sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
)

objects.name: song_curriculum_links
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE song_curriculum_links (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, song_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES "songs"(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, subject TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT NOT NULL, relevance TEXT, link_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT "curriculum")

objects.name: song_sections
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE song_sections (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  song_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES songs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  label TEXT,
  section_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'verse'
    CHECK (section_type IN ('verse', 'chorus', 'refrain', 'bridge', 'intro', 'outro', 'other')),
  sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL,
  lyrics TEXT NOT NULL,
  actions TEXT,
  action_scope TEXT CHECK (action_scope IN ('line', 'section', 'song')),
  action_line_number INTEGER,
  action_provenance TEXT CHECK (action_provenance IN ('source-documented', 'expert-suggested', 'community-legacy')),
  UNIQUE (song_id, sort_order)
)

objects.name: song_sources
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE song_sources (
  song_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES songs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  source_document_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES source_documents(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,

  locator TEXT,

objects.name: songs
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE "songs" (
    id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    title    TEXT NOT NULL,
    artist       TEXT, -- added during migration prep: real data on all 561 live rows, doc's
                        -- own note said this should exist and it didn't yet
    catalog      TEXT, -- reviewed: doc gave these as examples, not a closed enum (research
                        -- tier + other artists like Raffi/Seeger will add more), so left open
    lyrics       TEXT,
    url          TEXT,
    instructions TEXT, -- added during migration prep: symmetric with ACTIVITIES.instructions
    actions      TEXT,
    age_range   TEXT,
    source_id   INTEGER,
    verified    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (verified IN (0, 1)), type TEXT, educational_domain TEXT, materials_needed TEXT, tags TEXT, creator_artist TEXT, source_title TEXT, curriculum_links TEXT, early_years_links TEXT, markdown_path TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (source_id) REFERENCES "sources" (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)

objects.name: tags
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE "tags" (
    id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    parent_tag_id  INTEGER,

    definition     TEXT,

objects.name: topic_grades
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE "topic_grades" (

    topic_id  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    grade_id  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (topic_id) REFERENCES "topics" (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,

objects.name: topic_materials
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE "topic_materials" (
    id                 INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    topic_id           INTEGER NOT NULL,
    material_kind      TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (material_kind IN ('song', 'activity',
                                                               'book', 'resource')),
    material_id        INTEGER NOT NULL,
    role               TEXT CHECK (role IN ('focus', 'supporting')),
    use_in_phase       TEXT CHECK (use_in_phase IN ('opening', 'direct-instruction',
                                                      'guided-practice',
                                                      'independent-practice', 'closing')),
    routine_slot       TEXT CHECK (routine_slot IS NULL OR routine_slot IN
                                    ('circle-time-core', 'greeting', 'transition',
                                     'calm-down', 'goodbye')),
    teacher_rationale  TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (topic_id) REFERENCES "topics" (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    UNIQUE (topic_id, material_kind, material_id)
)

objects.name: topic_standards
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE "topic_standards" (

    topic_id          INTEGER NOT NULL,
    standard_id       INTEGER NOT NULL,
    alignment_notes   TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (topic_id) REFERENCES "topics" (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (standard_id) REFERENCES "standards" (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    UNIQUE (topic_id, standard_id)
)

objects.name: topic_tags
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE "topic_tags" (

    topic_id  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    tag_id    INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (topic_id) REFERENCES "topics" (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (tag_id) REFERENCES "tags" (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,

)

objects.name: topics
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE "topics" (

    subject_id       INTEGER NOT NULL,

    topic     TEXT NOT NULL,

    taught_status           TEXT, merged_into INTEGER REFERENCES "topics"(id), circle_time TEXT,

objects.name: weekly_pacing
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE "weekly_pacing" (

    topic_grade_id  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    week_number     INTEGER,

objects.name: search_chunks_ad
search_chunks_ai
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER search_chunks_ai AFTER INSERT ON search_chunks BEGIN
    INSERT INTO search_chunks_fts (rowid, id, kind, title, chunk_text, lyrics, instructions, source_path)
    VALUES (new.rowid, new.id, new.kind, new.title, new.chunk_text, new.lyrics, new.instructions, new.source_path);
  END

objects.name: search_chunks_au
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER search_chunks_au AFTER UPDATE ON search_chunks BEGIN
    UPDATE search_chunks_fts
    SET id = new.id,
        kind = new.kind,
        title = new.title,
        chunk_text = new.chunk_text,
        lyrics = new.lyrics,
        instructions = new.instructions,
        source_path = new.source_path
    WHERE rowid = new.rowid;
  END
